verdict.rationale: Deel's own payroll pages say it lets you "pay every worker type, in every country, from one platform," running payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers across 150+ countries. That directly matches paying employees and contractors from one system. The support rests on marketing-level claims, and the pack never names US W-2 or 1099 handling specifically. missing for 10: explicit US W-2 payroll and 1099 contractor payment/tax-form documentation, in-depth product docs beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
